rejected_single_discovery.scope: Read-only driver capability check: does go list -export -n produce both selected-file metadata and a link action?
rejected_single_discovery.decision: Plain go list -export -n cannot replace the current two-command discovery: it does not emit the root linker action. Go internal/work/exec.go explicitly skips linking when IsCmdList. No production change.

provenance: The standalone probe uses the final production behavior: later edits added fallback tests and a callback-contract comment only. Full CI, bootstrap, closures and integration suites use 8de6eb9. Baseline ee0e3c4 and merged main 41e25a2 have identical trees. Timing runs did not overlap other local builds. No cold filesystem or network timing is claimed.
